job: Sign in or create an account, with a password, a provider or an emailed code, beside a panel that says what Ember is.
purpose: A split screen for the product's front door: the form in a side panel (providers, email and password with a reveal, or a sign-in link with its code) and a sunken card of what Ember does beside it. Sign up adds a strength meter. A wrong password, a lock after too many tries and an unreachable service each say what happened and what to do next.
useWhen: A product needs a sign-in and sign-up page with room to say what it is.
The person may sign in with a provider, a password or an emailed code.

avoidWhen.when: The sign-in is a single centred card with no side story.
The person is already signed in and only needs to confirm a decision.
The person is just set up and needs to be guided through first steps.

states.name: sign in
states.how: the default: social buttons, email and password, an email-link option

states.name: sign up
states.how: ?state=signup: name, work email, a password strength meter and the terms

states.name: link sent
states.how: ?state=sent: the one-time code in fd-otp, Resend, Use a different email

states.name: locked
states.how: ?state=locked: a warning callout, fields and Sign in disabled; the email link still works

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error: a danger callout with Try again; nothing the person typed is lost
